text:
Anya: heads-up — HelioPay legal wants a single-sheet acceptance criteria + runbook before they route contract to procurement. can we finalize today?
Ravi: yep. they originally asked for p95 <200ms @200 QPS. i recommend we set p95 <260ms and p99 <650ms to account for production variance.
Anya: also need a short pricing appendix: reserved sizing vs burst/ondemand. they'll use it to compare vendors.
Leo: traffic profile i plan to use: 65% text-gen short prompts (~30 tokens), 25% text-gen long (~150 tokens), 10% embeddings. i'll attach the k6 mix.
Ravi: test config notes: KV/prefix cache enabled, batch_size=6 (closer to their client batching), prewarm 8 minutes. will pin model to rwd-instruct-1.2.Quantized to match prod var.
Anya: security asks: they require IP allowlist, KMS details (customer-managed ok?), and confirmation we retain audit logs for 90 days.
Legal: KMS customer-managed is available in Private deployments; for Hosted we can integrate with CMK via our KMS connector. audit log retention is 90 days standard or extended for an extra fee.
Leo: proposed run steps:
- quick smoke: 5 QPS x 3m
- ramp: 5 -> 200 QPS over 12m
- steady: 200 QPS x 35m (collect steady state)
- surge: 400 QPS x 90s x 2 iterations (validate degradation/failover)
k6 command:
```
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 35m helio_mix_v2.js
```
Anya: metrics we must capture in the handoff doc: p50/p90/p95/p99 lat, success rate, tokens/sec, model_version, KV hit %, 5xx count, GPU mem and util.
Ravi: ran a quick internal smoke: p95=160ms, p99=410ms @110 QPS with batch=6 on a T4-equivalent. not production but helpful baseline.
OpsBot: SOC2 Type II and standard uptime SLA uploaded to /shared/pocs/heliopay/links.txt (posted).
Anya: pricing roughs — ops, confirm: reserved pool to sustain 200 QPS (their token mix) ~= $20k/mo, optional burst cushion to 400 QPS adds ~$4k/mo amortized. put a note that exact depends on avg tokens per request.
Ravi: acceptance criteria (proposed to customer):
- sustain 200 QPS for 30 minutes with success rate >= 99.5%
- p95 < 260ms, p99 < 650ms
- no unexpected 5xx during steady window and graceful degradation verified during surge
If HelioPay agrees we'll lock a Wed or Thu slot next week.
Anya: i'll send the acceptance doc + IP CIDR request. Legal: confirm we can state KMS integration and audit retention text for the doc?
Legal: yes, send the exact wording you want and we can sign off.
Leo: uploading k6 scripts and payloads to the poc bucket and will paste link here shortly.
Anya: thanks team. once i have IPs and a signed consent i'll create the calendar event and tag ops for the run. :white_check_mark:
